name: Adaptation
description: You can survive and function in hostile environments (vacuum, underwater, extreme temperatures, toxic atmospheres, etc.). Each rank covers one environment type. You do not need to eat, sleep, or breathe while adapted.
notes: Number of environments per rank needs verification from PDF.

name: Alternate Form
description: You can transform into a radically different form (e.g. a cloud of bats, a swarm of insects, a monstrous shape). While transformed, you can use Powers associated with that form. Rank determines how quickly you transform and the range of forms available.

name: Animal Control
description: You can command and control animals. Make an attack roll against the target animal's passive defense; success allows you to issue mental commands. Controlled animals act on your initiative. Rank determines how many animals you can control simultaneously and the complexity of commands.

name: Animal Empathy
description: You can sense the emotions and intentions of animals and communicate with them in a basic way. Higher ranks allow more complex communication and may allow you to calm or befriend animals automatically.

name: Animal Mimicry
description: You can copy the physical traits and Powers of any animal (claws, enhanced senses, flight, venom, etc.). Rank determines the rank of the mimicked traits. You may mimic one animal's traits at a time.

name: Animation
description: You can animate inanimate objects, causing them to move and act under your mental direction. The animated object uses your Power rank for challenge rolls. Rank determines size and number of objects you can animate simultaneously.

name: Armor
description: You have a natural or constructed protective shell that reduces damage. Armor provides a passive defense bonus equal to its rank. Your effective Armor rank equals your Toughness rank divided by 2 (rounded up) plus any purchased ranks.

prerequisite.description: Baseline rank equals half Toughness rank (rounded up). Total Armor rank = baseline + purchased ranks.

name: Astral Projection
description: You can project your consciousness out of your body as an astral form. Your astral form is invisible and intangible (unless the Phase Shift Pro is purchased). Rank determines range and duration of projection. Your body remains inert while projecting.

name: Attuned
description: You have a supernatural connection to a specific person, object, or type of thing. You always know the direction and approximate distance to your attuned subject. Higher ranks provide more precise information and longer range.

name: Aura
description: Your body radiates a damaging energy field. Anyone who touches you or whom you touch suffers damage equal to your Aura rank. You may activate or deactivate the aura at will (unless the Constant Con is applied).

name: Banish
description: You can banish extradimensional entities (demons, spirits, outsiders, etc.) back to their home dimension. Make an attack roll against the target's passive defense; success sends them back. Rank determines which types of entities you can banish and the permanence of the effect.

name: Blast
description: You can project a ranged energy or force attack. Make an attack roll against the target; successes inflict damage. Blast is a Distant Range Power by default.

name: Blending
description: You can camouflage yourself to match your surroundings. While blending, you are difficult to spot: opposing Perception rolls suffer a penalty based on your Blending rank. Unlike Invisibility, Blending requires you to remain still or move slowly to remain concealed.

name: Blind
description: You can temporarily blind a target by overwhelming their vision. Make an attack roll; success blinds the target for a number of pages equal to your net successes. Blinded characters suffer severe penalties on attacks and defense.

name: Blind Fighting
description: You can fight effectively without relying on sight. Rank reduces or eliminates attack penalties for blindness, darkness, or fighting Invisible or Undetectable opponents. At sufficient rank, you can detect opponents through sound, scent, or other non-visual senses.

name: Blink
description: You can teleport short distances instantly. Rank determines maximum blink distance. Unlike full Teleportation, Blink is limited in range but can be used as part of movement or even in response to an attack.

name: Boost
description: You can temporarily increase the rank of one of your own or an ally's Traits (Ability, Talent, or Power) by an amount up to your Boost rank. The effect lasts for the rest of the scene or until canceled. Define the specific Trait boosted when purchasing.

name: Clairvoyance
description: You can project your senses to a distant location, perceiving what is happening there through sight and sound. Rank determines range and clarity. While using Clairvoyance, your awareness of your immediate surroundings is reduced.

name: Cloud Minds
description: You can make people subconsciously ignore your presence. Unlike Invisibility, you remain physically visible — observers simply fail to register your presence as significant. Make a challenge roll vs. targets' Willpower. Effect ends if you take any hostile action.

name: Communications
description: You can communicate over great distances, either by broadcasting your thoughts directly or by interfacing with communication systems. Rank determines range. You can also intercept, jam, or tap communications at equivalent rank.

name: Constructs
description: You can create solid objects or structures out of energy or matter. Constructs have Health and passive defense based on your rank. You may use them as cover, barriers, platforms, weapons, or tools. Constructs last until destroyed or you dismiss them.

name: Danger Sense
description: You have a preternatural awareness of threats. Your effective Danger Sense rank equals your Perception rank plus purchased ranks. Danger Sense is added to your Edge score (along with Perception and the higher of Agility or Intellect). You cannot be surprised.

prerequisite.description: Baseline rank equals Perception rank. Total Danger Sense rank = Perception + purchased ranks. Adds to Edge.

name: Darkness
description: You can project or create areas of supernatural darkness that blocks light of all kinds. Rank determines the area covered and how thoroughly all light is blocked. Characters without alternative senses suffer blindness penalties within the darkness.

name: Dazzle
description: You can overload a target's senses (sight, hearing, or other — chosen at purchase). Make an attack roll; success impairs the target's affected sense for a number of pages equal to your net successes. Targets can only use passive defense against Dazzle.

name: Deflection
description: You can deflect or redirect ranged attacks. On your turn you may forgo your action to use Deflection as a passive defense bonus against ranged attacks. At higher ranks you may redirect deflected attacks back at the attacker or at other targets.

name: Density
description: You can increase or decrease your body's density. Increasing density raises your effective Might and Armor rank but slows movement. Decreasing density makes you lighter and can grant partial intangibility. Rank determines the magnitude of density change.

name: Detection
description: You can detect a specific type of thing (energy, life forms, power signatures, chemicals, etc. — defined at purchase). Rank determines range and precision. Multiple applications of this Power detect different things.

name: Determination
description: You have extraordinary willpower and inner reserves. Each rank of Determination gives you 1 additional Resolve at the start of each scene. This Resolve is in addition to Resolve gained from normal character creation.
notes: Verify exact Resolve per rank ratio from PDF.

name: Dimensional Travel
description: You can travel between dimensions or parallel worlds. Rank determines frequency of use, accuracy of destination, and the number of passengers you can bring. Lower ranks may limit you to adjacent dimensions; higher ranks allow travel to any known dimension.

name: Dispel
description: You can cancel or suppress a target's Powers. Make an attack roll against the target's passive defense; success suppresses one Power (chosen by you) for a number of pages equal to your net successes. Rank determines which Powers you can affect.

name: Drain
description: You can temporarily reduce the rank of a target's Trait (Ability, Talent, or Power — defined at purchase). Make an attack roll; each net success reduces the target's chosen Trait by 1d for the rest of the scene. Drained ranks recover at end of scene.

name: Duplication
description: You can create duplicate copies of yourself. Each duplicate is a separate character with the same stats as you. Rank determines the number of duplicates you can maintain simultaneously. Duplicates are fully independent but share your experiences when reabsorbed.

name: Elemental Control
description: You can manipulate a specific element (fire, water, earth, air, electricity, etc. — defined at purchase). Rank determines the volume of material you can affect and the precision of your control. You can use the element offensively (attack rolls) or defensively.

name: Emotion Control
description: You can manipulate the emotional states of others (fear, courage, love, rage, despair, etc. — defined at purchase). Make an attack roll against the target's Willpower; success alters their emotional state for a number of pages equal to your net successes.

name: Energy Absorption
description: You can absorb a specific type of energy attack (defined at purchase) and convert it to fuel your own Powers or reduce damage taken. Rank determines how much energy you can absorb per page. Excess absorbed energy may be redirected as an attack.

name: Ensnare
description: You can trap and restrain a target with bonds of energy, webbing, ice, or similar. Make an attack roll; net successes reduce the target's ability to move and act. A restrained target cannot move and suffers penalties to attack and defense. The target may attempt to break free each page.

name: Evasion
description: You have extraordinary defensive reflexes. Your effective Evasion rank equals your Agility rank plus purchased ranks. Evasion may be used as a passive defense rank in combat without spending an action. Evasion is used passively against attacks you are unaware of.

prerequisite.description: Baseline rank equals Agility rank. Total Evasion rank = Agility + purchased ranks. Used as passive defense.

name: Expertise
description: You have in-depth knowledge of a specific career, discipline, or field not covered by standard Talents (e.g. chef, architect, musician, spy tradecraft). Define the area of expertise when purchasing. Rank determines the depth and breadth of your knowledge.

name: Extra Limbs
description: You have additional functional limbs (tentacles, tails, extra arms, etc.). Each rank provides one additional limb. Extra limbs allow you to carry more items, grapple more effectively, or perform additional actions with a limb without an action penalty.

name: Flight
description: You can fly under your own power. Rank determines flight speed. Flight is a sustained Power by nature — you must be actively using it to stay aloft.

name: Force Field
description: You project an active energy shield that provides a defense bonus against attacks. Unlike Armor, a Force Field is an active defense — it must be consciously maintained. Force Field is immune to the Penetrating Pro. Rank determines the strength of the field.

name: Form — Energy
description: You can transform your body into a form of pure energy (light, electricity, plasma, etc. — defined at purchase). While in energy form you are immune to physical damage, can travel at high speed, and may affect targets with a touch attack. Rank determines duration and which Powers you can use in this form.

name: Form — Gaseous
description: You can transform your body into a cloud of gas. While in gaseous form you can move through small openings, are immune to physical strikes, and are nearly invisible at range. You cannot use most physical Powers while gaseous. Rank determines duration and gas volume.

name: Form — Liquid
description: You can transform your body into a liquid state. While in liquid form you can flow through tiny gaps, absorb physical impacts, and reform after being hit. Rank determines the properties of the liquid and which actions you can take while transformed.

name: Form — Solid
description: You can transform your body into a solid material (stone, metal, crystal, wood, etc. — defined at purchase). While in solid form you gain enhanced Armor and Might but may move more slowly. Rank determines the hardness of the material and related bonuses.

name: Gestalt
description: You can merge with one or more other characters (who must also have this Power) to form a single combined entity with enhanced traits and Powers. The combined form has stats and Powers based on all participants. Rank determines how many others you can merge with and the power of the gestalt form.

name: Growth
description: You can increase your physical size. Each rank of Growth increases your effective Might and Armor by 1d (you become harder to harm and more powerful), but also makes you easier to hit (opponents gain a bonus to attack rolls against you). Growth also increases your reach.

name: Hard to Kill
description: You are extraordinarily difficult to kill. Each rank of Hard to Kill increases your Health by 2. You may also have enhanced thresholds for when you become incapacitated.
notes: Verify exact Health bonus per rank from PDF.

name: Healing
description: You can heal the damage and injuries of others. Make a challenge roll; each net success heals 1 point of damage. Rank determines the maximum damage you can heal per use and your range (Touch by default). Cannot heal yourself unless the Imbue Pro is purchased.

name: Hibernation
description: You can enter a state of suspended animation, dramatically reducing your biological functions. While hibernating you do not need food, water, or air, and you are immune to many environmental hazards. Rank determines how long you can hibernate and how quickly you can rouse yourself.

name: Hyper Breath
description: You can project a powerful breath weapon (fire, ice, acid, force, sonic, etc. — defined at purchase). This is a Close Range cone attack by default, affecting all targets in the area. Make one attack roll against all targets. Rank determines damage and range.

name: Illusions
description: You can create convincing sensory illusions that affect sight and sound (and other senses at higher ranks). Targets who interact with an illusion may make a Perception roll (vs. your Illusions rank) to disbelieve it. Rank determines realism, size, and number of illusions you can maintain.

name: Immortality
description: You cannot be permanently killed. When your Health reaches 0 you are incapacitated but not dead — you will recover after a time determined by your rank. You also do not age. Higher ranks recover more quickly and may grant other life-sustaining benefits.

name: Immunity
description: You are completely immune to a specific type of attack, hazard, or condition (defined at purchase — e.g. fire, poison, mind control, disease). Rank determines the breadth of the immunity. Multiple applications cover different immunity types.

name: Inanimate
description: You are, or can become, an inanimate object type (robot, golem, vehicle, etc. — defined at purchase as a Source). Characters with this Power may be immune to some Powers that affect living beings and vulnerable to others. Rank determines the extent of your inanimate nature.

name: Invisibility
description: You can become invisible to normal sight. Rank determines whether other senses (hearing, scent, radar) also reveal your presence, and whether carried items also become invisible. Attacking while invisible ends the effect until your next turn.

name: Irritant
description: You can produce a substance or effect that causes intense irritation (tear gas, pepper spray, blinding powder, itching powder, etc.). Make an attack roll; success causes the target to suffer penalties on all actions for a number of pages equal to your net successes.

name: Languages
description: You have an extraordinary facility with languages. Each rank allows you to understand and speak additional languages, or grants you the ability to understand any spoken or written language. Higher ranks may allow instant comprehension of any language encountered.
notes: Verify whether this is per-language flat cost or per-rank with comprehension scaling.

name: Leadership
description: You have a supernatural ability to inspire and coordinate allies. Allies within range gain a bonus to their rolls equal to your Leadership rank. You may also use Leadership to coordinate team attacks, granting bonuses when allies act in concert.

name: Leaping
description: You can leap extraordinary distances. Your effective Leaping rank equals half your Might rank (rounded up) plus purchased ranks. Rank determines jump distance and height. At sufficient rank you can use Leaping as an attack (landing on opponents).

prerequisite.description: Baseline rank equals half Might rank (rounded up). Total Leaping rank = baseline + purchased ranks.

name: Life Drain
description: You can drain the life force of a living being. Make an attack roll against the target; each net success inflicts 1 point of damage and heals 1 point of your own damage. Targets reduced to 0 Health by Life Drain may suffer additional effects at higher ranks.

name: Light / Effect
description: You can create and control light, including generating illumination, laser effects, holograms, or blinding flashes. Rank determines brightness, precision, and range. Primarily a utility Power; offensive light effects are handled by Blast or Dazzle.

name: Lightning Reflexes
description: You react with superhuman speed. Each rank of Lightning Reflexes adds +2 to your Edge score (in addition to Perception and the higher of Agility or Intellect). You also act earlier in the initiative order.
notes: Verify exact Edge bonus per rank (summary says +6 total for Lightning Reflexes — may be flat, not per-rank).

name: Luck
description: You can manipulate probability in your favor. Rank determines how many times per scene you can invoke Luck and the magnitude of the effect (rerolling dice, forcing opponents to reroll, causing improbable coincidences). GM has final say on Luck's narrative effects.

name: Machine Control
description: You can interface with and control mechanical and electronic devices. Rank determines the complexity of devices you can control and the range of control. At higher ranks you may be able to control complex systems such as vehicles, computers, or robot armies.

name: Martial Arts
description: You are trained in a martial discipline. Your effective Martial Arts rank equals your Might rank plus purchased ranks. Martial Arts may be used for unarmed attacks and also as an active defense roll in combat. Martial Arts can substitute for Strike when used unarmed.

prerequisite.description: Baseline rank equals Might rank. Total Martial Arts rank = Might + purchased ranks. Can be used as active defense.

name: Master of Disguise
description: You can create extraordinarily convincing disguises. Rank determines how different from your natural appearance you can appear and how long the disguise takes to apply. At higher ranks you can also alter your voice, scent, and other identifying characteristics.

name: Matter Chameleon
description: You can alter the material composition of your body to mimic other substances (metal, stone, rubber, etc.) without changing your shape. Each material grants different properties (hardness, conductivity, elasticity). Rank determines how many materials you can mimic and the quality of mimicry.

name: Mind Blast
description: You can project a powerful blast of psychic energy. Make an attack roll against the target's Willpower (passive); each net success inflicts damage directly to the target's mind. Mind Blast ignores physical armor. Targets resist with Psi-Screen if they have it.

name: Mind Control
description: You can take direct control of another person's mind and actions. Make an attack roll against the target's Willpower; success allows you to issue commands. Controlled targets act on your initiative. Rank determines how complex your commands can be and how many subjects you can control simultaneously.

name: Nullify
description: You can temporarily negate or suppress all Powers of a target (or Powers of a specific type — defined at purchase). Make an attack roll against the target's passive defense; success suppresses their Powers for a number of pages equal to your net successes.

name: Omni-Power
description: You have a versatile pool of power that you can configure as needed. Each page you may redistribute your Omni-Power rank among any Powers you wish (up to one rank per Power, or all ranks into one Power). Requires GM approval and is subject to narrative constraints of your Power source.
notes: Cost structure and rank redistribution rules need verification from PDF.

name: Phasing
description: You can become intangible, allowing you to pass through solid objects and ignore physical attacks. While phasing you cannot affect the physical world (carry objects, make physical attacks) unless you buy the Phase Shift Pro for specific Powers. Rank determines duration and whether you can bring others along.

name: Plasticity
description: Your body is highly malleable and elastic. You can reshape body parts, squeeze through tight spaces, and alter your general appearance (not a full disguise). Rank determines the extent of reshaping possible, elasticity, and ability to absorb impacts.

name: Polymorph
description: You can transform another character into a different form (an animal, an object, etc.). Make an attack roll against the target's passive defense; success transforms them for a duration based on your net successes. A transformed character cannot use most Powers. Rank determines how drastically you can transform targets.

name: Portable Storehouse
description: You have access to a pocket dimension or extradimensional space in which you can store equipment and supplies. Rank determines the volume of your storehouse and how quickly you can retrieve items from it. Living beings may not be stored.

name: Possession
description: You can project your mind into another person's body and take control, displacing their consciousness. Make an attack roll against the target's Willpower; success allows possession for a number of pages equal to your net successes. Your own body falls inert while possessing another.

name: Power Absorption
description: You can temporarily steal the Powers of another character. Make an attack roll against the target's passive defense; success allows you to use one of their Powers at your Power Absorption rank for a number of pages equal to your net successes. The target loses access to the stolen Power while it is absorbed.

name: Power Mimicry
description: You can copy the Powers of other characters. Upon coming into contact with (or within range of) a character with Powers, you may copy one or more of their Powers at your Power Mimicry rank. Unlike Power Absorption, the target retains their Powers. Rank determines number of Powers copied and duration.

name: Precognition
description: You can perceive future events. Precognition provides visions, feelings, or impressions about what may occur. Rank determines how far into the future you can see, how clear the visions are, and how reliably you can invoke the ability (vs. it being involuntary).

name: Preparation
description: You can prepare equipment, traps, plans, or resources in advance that give significant advantages when deployed. Rank determines how many preparations you can have active at once and how quickly you can set them up. This Power represents extraordinary planning ability.

name: Psi-Screen
description: You have a powerful mental shield that defends against psychic attacks and mind-affecting Powers. Your effective Psi-Screen rank equals your Willpower rank plus purchased ranks. Psi-Screen acts as a passive defense against mental attacks (Mind Blast, Telepathy, Mind Control, etc.).

prerequisite.description: Baseline rank equals Willpower rank. Total Psi-Screen rank = Willpower + purchased ranks. Acts as passive defense against mental attacks.

name: Psychometry
description: By touching an object or location, you can perceive its history — events that occurred in connection with it. Rank determines how far back in time you can perceive, how detailed the visions are, and whether you can perceive only significant events or mundane ones too.

name: Quick Change
description: You can change into your costume or another outfit in an instant, without requiring a place to change or time to prepare. Rank determines how fast the change is and whether it includes other transformation effects (such as disguise or alternate identity).

name: Radar
description: You have a radar or sonar sense that allows you to detect the location and movement of objects and beings regardless of light conditions. Rank determines range and resolution. Radar negates blindness penalties and can detect hidden or invisible objects.

name: Regeneration
description: You heal from injuries with extraordinary speed. Each rank of Regeneration allows you to recover 1 point of damage per page automatically. This healing occurs regardless of medical attention. At high ranks, regeneration may also repair severed limbs or counteract poisons and diseases.

name: Resistance
description: You are resistant to a specific type of attack or hazard (defined at purchase — e.g. fire, poison, electricity, cold). Your effective Resistance rank equals your Toughness rank plus purchased ranks. Resistance provides a passive defense bonus against the specified attack type.

prerequisite.description: Baseline rank equals Toughness rank. Total Resistance rank = Toughness + purchased ranks. Applies only to the defined damage type.

name: Running
description: You can run at superhuman speeds. Your effective Running rank starts at 3d (baseline) plus purchased ranks. Rank determines how fast you can move on foot. At higher ranks you may perform additional actions while running or have other super-speed effects.

prerequisite.description: Baseline rank is fixed at 3d regardless of abilities. Total Running rank = 3d + purchased ranks.

name: Separation
description: You can split your body into separate pieces that act independently and then recombine. Rank determines how many pieces you can create, how far apart they can be, and how independently they can act. Each piece retains a portion of your abilities.

name: Shockwave
description: You can generate a powerful shockwave of force or energy that radiates outward from you, striking all nearby targets. Make one attack roll and apply it against all targets in the area. Active defense ranks are halved against Shockwave. Rank determines damage and range.

name: Shrinking
description: You can reduce your physical size. Rank determines how small you can become. Shrinking makes you harder to hit (opponents suffer attack penalties) and grants access to small spaces. At extreme ranks you can approach sub-atomic scale. Your Might decreases proportionally with size.

name: Slay
description: You have the ability to instantly kill or destroy a specific type of target (defined at purchase — e.g. demons, undead, robots, a specific species). Make an attack roll; against the defined target type, success results in immediate incapacitation or death regardless of Health. Rank determines how powerful the targets you can affect are.

name: Slick
description: You can create an extremely slippery surface (oil slick, ice patch, etc.) on the ground or another surface. Targets entering or attempting to move through the area must make challenge rolls or fall. Rank determines area covered and difficulty of the challenge rolls.

name: Speak with Dead
description: You can communicate with the spirits or residual consciousness of deceased beings. Rank determines how long after death you can contact a spirit, how clear the communication is, and whether the spirit is compelled to answer or can choose to remain silent.

name: Specialty
description: You have extraordinary expertise in a very specific application of a Talent or Ability (e.g. safecracking within Covert, forensic analysis within Investigation). Each rank provides a bonus die when performing that specific activity. Define the specialty when purchasing.

name: Spinning
description: You can spin your body at high speed, generating a centrifugal force effect. While spinning you deflect projectiles, create wind effects, and can use the spin as an attack against adjacent targets. Rank determines spin speed and the power of associated effects.

name: Star Gate
description: You can create stable portals that others can pass through, connecting two distant points in space or even between dimensions. Unlike Teleportation, Star Gates are two-way openings that persist for a duration. Rank determines size, range, stability, and duration of the gate.

name: Stretching
description: You can extend your limbs, neck, and torso to extraordinary lengths. Rank determines your maximum reach (allowing melee attacks at range), how many body parts you can extend simultaneously, and the maximum extension length.

name: Strike
description: You have enhanced melee striking power — through energy-charged fists, claws, a weapon, or sheer force. Your effective Strike rank equals your Might rank plus purchased ranks. Used in place of a standard Might attack roll in melee combat.

prerequisite.description: Baseline rank equals Might rank. Total Strike rank = Might + purchased ranks.

name: Stun
description: You can deliver an attack that stuns rather than injures. Make an attack roll; net successes stun the target for that many pages. A stunned target cannot act and has their defenses reduced. Stun attacks cause no lasting damage.

name: Summoning
description: You can call forth entities (spirits, demons, animals, constructs, etc. — defined at purchase) to serve you. Summoned beings arrive at your location and follow your commands. Rank determines how powerful the beings you can summon are and how many you can have active simultaneously.

name: Super Senses
description: You have enhanced or additional senses beyond normal human capability. Each application of this Power grants one enhanced sense or one new sense (defined at purchase). Examples include: Infravision, Microscopic Vision, Telescopic Vision, X-Ray Vision, Ultra-Hearing, Sonar, Tremor-Sense, Olfactory Tracking, Electromagnetic Sense. Rank determines the acuity of the sense.
notes: Each specific super sense should be purchased as a separate application of this Power.

name: Super Speed
description: You can move and act at superhuman speed. Super Speed provides exceptional movement rate and also allows extra actions per page (based on rank). At high ranks you can vibrate through matter, create wind vortexes, or perform time-affecting feats. Also adds to Edge.
notes: Exact extra-actions mechanic and Edge bonus needs verification from PDF.

name: Swimming
description: You can swim at superhuman speeds and operate freely underwater. Rank determines swim speed and depth you can reach without environmental hazards. May include adaptations for underwater breathing if purchased with Adaptation.

name: Swing Line
description: You can move rapidly through urban environments by firing lines, webs, or energy tethers and swinging between anchor points. Rank determines swing speed and range. In open terrain without anchor points, Swing Line may not be usable.

name: Telekinesis
description: You can move objects and people with the power of your mind. Rank determines the weight you can lift and move (using the Weight table) and range. You can use Telekinesis for fine manipulation or as a blunt attack (damaging thrown objects or crushing force).

name: Telepathy
description: You can read and send thoughts. Rank determines range, how deeply you can probe (surface thoughts vs. buried memories), and whether targets are aware of the intrusion. Contested by Psi-Screen as passive defense. Communication use does not require an attack roll.

name: Teleportation
description: You can instantly transport yourself (and others, at higher ranks) from one location to another. Rank determines range, accuracy, and number of passengers. You must have line of sight or a detailed mental image of the destination at lower ranks.

name: Time Stop
description: You can temporarily freeze time for everyone except yourself. While time is stopped you can move, manipulate objects, and prepare actions. Other characters cannot act, perceive you, or defend. Rank determines how long you can stop time per use and how often you can use it.

name: Time Travel
description: You can travel to different points in time. Rank determines how accurately you can target a time period, how many passengers you can bring, and how far into the past or future you can travel. Time paradox effects are at GM discretion.

name: Total Recall
description: You have a perfect eidetic memory. You remember everything you have ever seen, read, or heard with total clarity. Rank determines how quickly you can access memories and whether you can apply memories for practical bonuses (e.g. recalling a combat technique you once observed).

name: Tracer
description: You can mark a target (by touch, by attaching a device, or by psychic imprint — defined at purchase) and then track them unerringly. Rank determines range at which you can track the target and how much detail you receive about their location and state.

name: Transformation — Animal Forms
description: You can transform into one or more specific animal forms (defined at purchase). While transformed you gain the physical capabilities and applicable Powers of the chosen animal at your Power rank. Rank determines transformation speed and how many different animal forms you have access to.

name: Transformation — Doppelganger
description: You can perfectly replicate the appearance of any person you have seen (or touched, at lower ranks). Rank determines how accurate the duplication is (appearance only vs. voice, scent, mannerisms) and whether your stats change to match the target.

name: Transformation — Object Forms
description: You can transform your body into a specific inanimate object or class of objects (defined at purchase). While transformed you are indistinguishable from the object and may gain the object's properties. Rank determines transformation speed and the range of objects you can become.

name: Transformation — Shapeshifting
description: You can alter your physical form freely, changing your appearance, size (within limits), and gaining limited physical abilities of assumed forms. Unlike more specialized Transformation powers, Shapeshifting is broadly applicable. Rank determines the extent and speed of transformation and whether gained traits function mechanically.

name: Transmutation
description: You can change the material composition of objects (and at higher ranks, living beings) — turning lead to gold, stone to glass, etc. Make a challenge roll against the object's passive resistance (or a target's passive defense for living beings). Rank determines the volume of material you can affect and the complexity of transformation.

name: Tunneling
description: You can burrow through solid matter. Rank determines tunneling speed and the hardness of material you can move through. You may leave a stable tunnel behind you or collapse it as you go. At higher ranks you can tunnel through nearly any material.

name: Two-Dimensional
description: You can flatten your body to a paper-thin two-dimensional state, allowing you to slide under doors, through cracks, and be virtually undetectable face-on. While two-dimensional you are extremely vulnerable to physical attacks from the side but immune to many conventional assaults.

name: Two-Fisted
description: You can fight effectively with a weapon or attack in each hand simultaneously. Rank reduces or eliminates penalties for attacking with two weapons or two attacks per action. At higher ranks you may make additional off-hand attacks as free actions.

name: Vanish
description: You can disappear from sight in an instant, even when being directly observed. Unlike Invisibility (which is sustained), Vanish is instantaneous — you use it to break line of sight or escape observation. Rank determines how completely you disappear and whether technological sensors are also fooled.

name: Variant
description: This Power is an alternate application of another Power you own, sharing the same source or device. A Variant costs fewer points because it piggybacks on an existing Power's infrastructure. The Variant Power cannot be used simultaneously with the Power it is a variant of (it shares the Exclusive Con by definition).
notes: Exact cost reduction and rules for Variant need verification from PDF.

name: Ventriloquism
description: You can project your voice perfectly to any location within range, creating the impression that sound is coming from elsewhere. Rank determines range and how convincing the projection is. At higher ranks you can mimic other voices precisely.

name: Wall-Crawling
description: You can cling to and move freely on vertical surfaces and ceilings. You do not need to make challenge rolls to maintain your grip under normal conditions. Rank determines your movement speed while wall-crawling and the types of surfaces you can cling to.

name: Weakness Detection
description: You can perceive the vulnerabilities and weak points of targets — physical, psychological, or Power-based. Rank determines how quickly you can identify weaknesses and how detailed the information you receive is. Using detected weaknesses may grant attack bonuses against that target.
